Appraiser remarks
The vehicle arrived with crushed front bumper cover, cracked grille and a displaced
hood latch, with the radiator support showing bending consistent with a frontal impact
at low speed. Some of the lower damage may have come from this collision, but it is not
yet clear whether all of it did, so the older-looking marks on the lower panels are
being checked before final approval. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper
cover, grille, hood latch and radiator support, with refinishing of the front end and a
scan for sensor faults. The labor hours listed fit the damage described. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known. Two similar charges on the same day are being checked
against the file before payment is released.
